intro: You need a new shirt for school. Talk to the shopkeeper.

conversation.speaker: shopkeeper
conversation.text: Good morning. How can I help you today?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say that you are looking for a shirt.
expected: I am looking for a shirt.
I want to buy a shirt.
conversation.hint: Try: "I am looking for a shirt."

conversation.speaker: shopkeeper
conversation.text: We have many shirts. What size do you need?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: I think I need a large size.

conversation.speaker: shopkeeper
conversation.text: Here is a white one and a blue one. Which colour do you like?

conversation.speaker: shopkeeper
conversation.text: Good choice. Would you like to try it on?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say yes and ask where you can try it.
expected: Yes, where can I try it?
Yes please, where is the changing room?
Yes, I would like to try it on.
conversation.hint: Try: "Yes, where can I try it?"

conversation.speaker: shopkeeper
conversation.text: It fits you well. That will be four hundred rupees.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say you will take it and thank him.
expected: I will take it, thank you.
Yes, I will buy it. Thank you.
I will take this one, thank you.
conversation.hint: Try: "I will take it, thank you."
